**General**
- Many bug and crash fixes
- [Linux] Restored `Ctrl`+`Q` shortcut to exit SLADE
- Added more options for the FluidSynth MIDI player
	- Sample rate (default 22050 hz)
	- Chorus effect (default off)
	- Reverb effect (default off)
- Various improvements to the settings dialog

**Game Formats & Features**
- Added support for HROT pak archive format (thanks @wolfmanfp)
- Added detection of 3ds model format (thanks @wolfmanfp)
- Added support for id24 `BRGHTMPS`, `DMXMIDI` and `SKYDEFS` (thanks @wolfmanfp)

**Resource Editor**
- Fixed palette translations generating incorrectly when the source and destination ranges have mismatching sizes
- Fixed issues with full file paths being used when importing a directory or building an archive from a directory
- Fixed wrong success/failure message after compiling ACS/DECOHack (thanks @electricbrass)

**Map Editor**
- Added the ability to toggle 'always mouselook' in 3d mode so it behaves the same as before, default keybind `M`
- Changed 'Auto-align Y' keybind to `Ctrl`+`Shift`+`A` so it does not trigger when strafing left with shift held down
- Added an option to fill missing textures after changing sector heights (on by default)
- Fixed very high scrolling sensitivity on touchpads with 'smooth' scrolling support
- Fixed look up/down keybinds being inverted when the mouselook y axis is inverted
- Fixed copy+paste of map architecture
- Fixed default thing flags not including sp/coop/dm in hexen format maps
